Synopsis:
Sweden is deploying Gripen fighter jets, corvettes, and anti-drone systems to Finland at least through end-2026, responding to a deteriorating security situation on NATO's northern flank. Drone incursions into Finnish and Baltic airspace — partly a spillover from Ukraine's strikes on Russian Baltic Sea oil shipping ports — are driving the escalation. SAAB separately secured a €126M Finnish order for RBS 70 NG air defence systems.
